{{Otheruses|Eclipse}}
'''Project Eclipse''' was an initiative sponsored by the [[Outreach Bureau]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Its approval came after the Bureau's previous success in overriding [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] feeds to distribute propaganda that led to demoralization and low recruitment rates in the Empire's enemies. Thus, the [[Dark Council]] approved of Project Eclipse that was an inter-ministerial program which involved military strikes and assassinations on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] wide scale that culminated in a key broadcast that consisted of a message of intimidation to the enemies of the Empire.<ref name="Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

The key to the project involved hijacking of a vital HoloNet hub by the Outreach Bureau on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, the [[Hutt Data Haven]] at [[Network Access]] was heavily guarded and thus the Bureau required the aid of an Imperial representative to clear the way in order for the speech to be broadcast.<ref name="Old Republic" />
